release_notes: Build 54 restores a missing YouTube OAuth desktop client ID from the previous development settings without overwriting an ID already configured in the installed app.
Existing installations now run a separate project-consolidation pass even when the earlier Build 52 migration marker already exists.
The configured legacy Quiz Projects folder is merged into the persistent installed projects folder under LocalAppData, while newer installed project files are preserved.
Quiz History paths, absolute project folder values and common project JSON/XML/text path references are rebased to installed storage so the development checkout can be removed after verification.
Legacy project files remain untouched during migration, and conflicting installed files that must be replaced are backed up before replacement.
The installed database, settings, API credentials and quiz projects remain together under the FactVaultManager LocalAppData root.
